fixes.title: Set time estimates for every order
fixes.rationale: Ask the kitchen head to estimate preparation times and have waiters share these with guests immediately when taking an order. This sets clear expectations so customers do not feel their time is being wasted while waiting for their food.

fixes.title: Add portion sizes to the menu
fixes.rationale: Print the weight or count of food items next to the prices on your menu. This shows customers exactly how much they are getting for their money, preventing the feeling that the portion is too small for the cost.

fixes.title: Train staff to provide hourly status updates
fixes.rationale: Instruct the front-of-house staff to proactively speak to guests if their service is delayed, rather than waiting for them to ask. This prevents frustration and makes the customer feel heard and respected even during busy hours.
